title: Pocket List
idea: Build a small offline command-line task list for one person. The program stores its data locally and keeps working without an internet connection.
goals: Add a task and save it locally
List unfinished tasks after restarting the program
Mark a task complete without losing other tasks
non_goals: No due dates, reminders, tags, or recurring tasks in the first release
constraints: Use Python 3.11 or newer and only the standard library
Store data in a human-readable local JSON file
Keep the command syntax and stored-data behavior testable
plan_review_reason: The deliverables are small, ordered, independently testable, and cover the accepted first release without adding excluded features.

goals.title: Add a task and save it locally
List unfinished tasks after restarting the program
Mark a task complete without losing other tasks

deliverables.title: Persistent add command
acceptance: Adding non-blank text appends a uniquely identified unfinished task to valid JSON.

deliverables.title: Restart-safe list command
acceptance: A new process lists unfinished tasks previously saved to disk.

deliverables.title: Lossless completion command
acceptance: Completing one task preserves every other stored task and reports unknown IDs safely.

tasks.title: Implement atomic task creation and JSON persistence
acceptance: Blank task text is rejected without changing data.
Valid tasks receive increasing integer IDs.
Writes replace the JSON file atomically.

tasks.title: Lock in add-command persistence regressions

dependency_rationale.3.1.1: The persistence behavior must exist before its regression suite is finalized.

acceptance: Tests cover reload, blank input, malformed data, and CLI output.

tasks.title: Implement restart-safe unfinished-task listing

dependency_rationale.3.1.2: Listing builds on the validated storage contract.

acceptance: Only unfinished tasks are listed after a fresh process reads the saved file.

tasks.title: Implement lossless task completion

dependency_rationale.3.2.1: Completion uses the same validated read/list storage flow.

acceptance: Completing one known ID changes only that task.
Unknown IDs fail without changing the file.
